kind: # Mapping for tools/effect_classify.py (see docs/subsystems/effect-classification.md). Lines starting with # are comments.
# kind: name = Python regex searched in the callee's registry name (a leading "thunk_" is removed first);
#       addr = callee address in hex; cmd = engine command code (op & 0xfff) posted through a "queue" callee;
#       arg  = "<name regex>|<register>&<mask>": the callee is called with that register holding a value whose
#              mask bits are all known to be set.
#       dispatch = "<name regex>" of a callee that calls a per-card handler from an 8-byte list; the category column
#              holds the list address (hex): the record's own handler in that list is classified too and its
#              categories are added to the slot (effect_classify.dispatched).
#       store = space-separated conditions "<address>=<value>" or "<address>&<mask>" that must all hold for
#              constant stores (sb/sh/sw of a known value to a known address) of one scanned function.
